meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 16 — Governance: Indonesia Democracy Index, anti-corruption / integrity framework, and related institutional-quality nodes.

candidates.title: Indonesia Democracy Index (IDI)
candidates.description: Official composite democracy index published by BPS at national, central and provincial levels (new method). Provides a statistical measure of democratic performance and its spatial variation across the 38 provinces.
referenced_by: International democracy assessments that cite official data

candidates.title: National Strategy for Corruption Prevention (Stranas PK) and integrity framework
candidates.description: Strategic anti-corruption and public-integrity framework (Stranas PK and successor instruments). Centres the formal regulatory architecture for conflict-of-interest, asset declaration, political finance and related integrity rules.

candidates.title: KPK – Corruption Eradication Commission institutional role
candidates.description: Specialised anti-corruption agency with investigation, prosecution and prevention mandates. Continuously cited in governance, integrity and rule-of-law analysis.

candidates.title: Asset-declaration and conflict-of-interest regulatory regime
candidates.description: Rules requiring asset declarations by elected officials, judges and civil servants, and related conflict-of-interest provisions. Part of the formal integrity architecture.

candidates.title: Indonesia governance and institutional-quality meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from BPS IDI, KPK and integrity-strategy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the Indonesia Democracy Index, National Strategy for Corruption Prevention, KPK institutional role, and asset-declaration / conflict-of-interest regime into a coherent governance and institutional-quality layer.
